name: Contact-Point Freeze Forehand
ageSkill: Ages 6–12 or adult starters · ITN 9–10 · UTR 1–3
objective: Groove a contact point in front of the lead hip with a stable finish.

cues: Turn the shoulders before the ball bounces | Meet it in front | Hold the statue finish

kpi_attempt: Player completes a full swing at the ball.
kpi_decision: Player sets up so contact happens in front of the cone (not beside or behind the body).
kpi_execution: Ball clears the net and lands in the singles court AND the finish is held balanced for 2 s.
measurement: Per set, tally four numbers on the Session Execution screen: (1) Eligible opportunities — every fed ball that bounces in the hitting zone at waist height is one opportunity. (2) Attempts — player completes a full swing at the ball. (3) Correct decisions — player sets up so contact happens in front of the cone (not beside or behind the body). (4) Successful executions — ball clears the net and lands in the singles court AND the finish is held balanced for 2 s. Tag each miss with an error type (net, long, wide, wrong choice, late). A sound decision that misses still earns decision credit; an attempt outside eligible conditions is logged as an attempt with no decision credit. Volume: 4 sets × 10 balls.
progression: Feeder moves to the opposite baseline and feeds with racquet; then live crosscourt rally.
regression: Drop-feed from beside the player with a foam ball and a mini-net.
safety: Clear loose balls from the hitting zone between sets; feeder stands beside the net post or behind a screen.

name: Inside-In Forehand Change of Direction
